name: Zephras Isle
summary: On Zephras Isle, the Skyborne face a homeland slowly coming apart. Air elementals once shared the island with them, but those guardians vanished and the magic that holds the land aloft is fading. Refugees arrive from Anvilas and Siroccas as those islands crumble.

sections.title: A Realm Aloft
sections.body: In skywall, the elemental plane of air, the Skyborne have lived on Zephras Isle for generations. Native air elementals once helped preserve the magical currents that keep the island aloft. Several centuries ago, those elementals vanished. Without their presence, the enchantments beneath the land have slowly weakened, and Zephras has begun to fracture.

sections.title: Severed Horizons
sections.body: Anvilas and Siroccas once drifted through skywall alongside Zephras, and the Skyborne made homes on all three islands. When the elementals vanished, communication between the islands ended. Now refugees from the crumbling neighbors have reached Zephras seeking safety. They report that the land beneath them on Anvilas and Siroccas is breaking apart.

sections.title: Threshold to Azeroth
sections.body: As Zephras decays, the Skyborne look beyond skywall toward Azeroth. Airships now set out from the skydocks of valanaar to make rare links with the mortal realm. Their voyages reach the outskirts of Dalaran in the alterac mountains and skywatcher plateau in Mulgore.

faq.answer: Zephras Isle floats within skywall, the elemental plane of air, rather than on Azeroth. Clouds and wind currents surround the island in that ethereal realm.

faq.q: Why is Zephras Isle falling apart?
faq.answer: Native air elementals once lived alongside the Skyborne and helped sustain Zephras Isle. They vanished several centuries ago, and the island's magical foundations have slowly weakened since.
Anvilas and Siroccas are neighboring floating island homes of the Skyborne in skywall. Contact with both ended when the elementals vanished, and refugees now report that the islands are collapsing.

faq.q: How do people travel between Zephras Isle and Azeroth?
faq.answer: The Skyborne launch airships from the skydocks at valanaar and cross into Azeroth. They reach the outskirts of Dalaran in the alterac mountains and skywatcher plateau in Mulgore.
The Skyborne have made their homes on Zephras Isle and its sister sky-realms for generations. Their floating island homeland is slowly breaking apart as its sustaining magic fades.

faq.q: Who lives on Zephras Isle besides the Skyborne?
faq.answer: Local bandits, cavern-dwelling nightclaws, and beasts live on Zephras Isle. They can be found in places such as the Shriekling Den and Nightclaw Cavern.

angles.text: As a Skyborne, Zephras Isle is your ancestral home and starting ground. Its beauty remains even as the land collapses and elemental power fades.
As a Shaman, you know Zephras Isle lies within the Elemental Plane of air. Its fading elemental power shows what happens when the spirits that sustain an elemental land disappear.
